llm.summary: This memory skill is purpose-aligned but should be reviewed because it encourages broad automatic capture and long-term reuse of conversation and memory data.

dimensions.detail: The skill targets broad memory sources including session logs, account-level MEMORY.md, knowledge.json, archived README files, and TRAE workflows, then may export to Obsidian and a GitHub-related repository/site, which is high-impact for private data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains only SKILL.md and _meta.json; no bundled executable code, installer, dependency manifest, or remote payload execution was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs daily full synchronization and session-end incremental capture of key conversation content without specifying opt-in, preview, exclusion, retention, or deletion controls.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent knowledge files, automatic distillation into long-term memory, scheduled daily runs, and future retrieval are core behaviors but are not bounded by clear user-directed controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is an external memory engine for vectorizing, persisting, retrieving, visualizing, and exporting agent memories, which matches the described commands and destinations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intentionally want an agent memory system that can persist conversation summaries and other local memory sources across sessions. Before enabling daily sync or session-end capture, confirm exactly what will be written, whether anything is pushed or published through GitHub, how sensitive content is excluded, and how stored memories can be reviewed and deleted.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Persistence and Obsidian/GitHub-related synchronization are expected for a memory engine, but the concern is valid because the artifact does not clearly require user review or consent before storing or exporting captured content.
[SQP-2] expected: Automatic daily ingestion and session-end incremental capture are aligned with the stated memory workflow, but they create a Review concern because ongoing collection is described without scoping, retention, or opt-out controls.
[SQP-3] expected: The artifact is written in Chinese and appears aimed at a Chinese-language workflow; this is a usability/localization note rather than a security concern by itself.
